title: Battle of Mudki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mudki", at revision 1370450730, opens: "The Battle of Mudki was fought on 18 December 1845, between the forces of the British East India Company and a part of the Sikh Khalsa Army, the army of the Sikh Empire. The British army were able to win the battle, despite suffering heavy casualties in the process." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q910528, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1845 battle of the Anglo-Sikh war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
